audit_scope: FULL CORPUS -- every currently-completed, valid (non-PRERESCUE_INVALIDATED) E2a world at the frozen snapshot, not a sample

methodology.selection: NONE -- every replayable world in the frozen snapshot was replayed, not a sample
methodology.snapshot_synchronization: a single population snapshot was frozen once (full_corpus_parity_audit.py --take-snapshot-to) and every parallel shard partitioned that IDENTICAL list (--frozen-snapshot-file), guaranteeing complete non-overlapping coverage -- verified directly: shard N_REPLAYABLE_THIS_SHARD values summed to exactly N_REPLAYABLE_GLOBAL
methodology.comparison: lazy_classify.lazy_evaluate_world replayed against each world's raw candidate rows (classification-derived fields discarded and recomputed via the real, unmodified classifier), compared to the already-sealed exhaustive first_loss_stage / representative_g2_correct / representative_truth_equivalent -- representative fields compared only where decision-relevant (see MURU_V2_E2_LAZY_CLASSIFICATION_SPEC.md section 4)
methodology.isolated_retry: 4 of 369 worlds exceeded a 90s per-world safety timeout on the main pass (0 mismatches among them or anywhere else -- these were ERRORs, not disagreements) and were resolved by one isolated, patient retry at a 600s timeout, mirroring this rescue's own Part X poison-world discipline (never mark a slow-but-possibly-correct world permanently failed without a dedicated retry). All 4 matched on retry.
methodology.determinism_check: 30-world deterministic (sorted-ID stride) subset, each replayed twice within the same worker process

note: No stage frequency, A/B/C/D/E count, E2b field, or routing-gate count appears anywhere in this file or was read to produce it beyond the minimum per-world label needed for the match/mismatch boolean, exactly as the mission's own Part V precedent authorizes.
